player_body.reason: r32 has no dedicated skeletal Piercing VMD; modern full-body Piercing is bypassed so the source-derived blade path can ride vanilla body/movement instead

notes: Frames 1..32 keep the classic neutral blade/saya pose. The modern lunge begins at frame 33, where the blade switches to the r32 Stinger full-thrust pose. Stinger's 20-tick reset clock converts to 30 VMD frames, so Noutou recovery starts at frame 63 and reaches neutral at frame 72. This is a visual interpretation, not a claim that modern Piercing existed in r32.
